title: AI-Based early warning and landslide Risk Monitoring System in NER
org: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER)
department: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER)
description: The North Eastern Region (NER) frequently faces landslides, flash floods, road blockages, and slope failures due to heavy rainfall, fragile terrain, and unplanned hill cutting. This problem statement proposes an AI-powered early warning and monitoring platform capable of predicting and tracking landslide-prone areas in real time across NER using rainfall patterns, soil moisture sensors, satellite imagery, and terrain slope data. Includes GIS mapping, crowdsourced geo-tagged field reporting, multilingual notifications, and offline sync for remote areas.
